headline: On 20 held-out seeds in simulated Indian mixed traffic, CHOWK showed no clear difference in delay per person versus area max-pressure (−0.1%, 95% CI −0.8% to +0.4%), with 4.0% lower delay versus Webster fixed-time (95% CI −4.8% to −3.2%). Simulation result.
